name: context-recall
description: Retrieve full pre-compaction conversation history from saved transcript files when the compact summary is insufficient or earlier session details are missing. Use when asked about past decisions, tool results, or content that predates the latest compaction; when mapping Done to Working Intent / Recent User Requests after compaction; before ui__reportResult(success) if intent or Completion Criteria are incomplete or unverified; when the agent would say it does not remember; or when the compact summary's Context recovery / fallback note names a transcript path. Triggers: "what did we discuss earlier", "before the context was reset", "older messages", "pre-compaction", "context recall", "recover history", "before declaring done", "컴팩션 이전 대화", "과거 히스토리", "예전에 뭐라고 했지", "아까 정한", "아까 뭐였지".
